ui_bugs.issue: Site Mode header still displays the copy 'Live · isolated to this tenant' next to the LIVE chip. Not explicitly banned by this iteration's spec, but the phrase 'isolated' conflicts with the always-live/auto-propagation narrative — worth rewording to just 'Live' or 'Live · master workspace' for consistency with the platform's new posture.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): Reword or drop 'isolated to this tenant' inside site-mode-live-badge — the new platform behavior is always-live auto-propagation from master workspace, so 'isolated' is misleading.
critical_code_review_comments: auto_propagate.py is content-safe by construction — only writes to apps.theme/motion_profile/site_mode and platform_settings.site_mode_defaults; never touches pages/blocks/CTAs/stats. Good separation.

SiteModePanel.tsx: data-speed / data-intensity are now on the sm-hero-live-render wrapper (fixes iter73 HIGH finding). Publish Row chips use disabled={busy} so rapid clicks are ignored while a PUT is in-flight (fixes iter73 MEDIUM race).
AppDetail.tsx line 121: header-master-badge only renders when appDoc.is_test_lab, and Test Lab tags are enforced to ['internal tools','website'] server-side via test_lab.ensure_test_lab — consistent.

One live tenant (app_testlab) means propagate_site_mode's tenant list is always empty; platform_settings.site_mode_defaults doc is the actual acceptance signal for propagation and is being written correctly (confirmed via GET after PUT).

editorial hero swap accepts only names in HERO_NAMES — spec's suggested 'aurora-mesh' would 400. Tests use 'aurora-wave' which is a valid hero. Consider exposing /api/editorial/heroes or a whitelist for future automation.
